outcome.Summary: Implemented package jpath in jpath/jpath.go: Query(doc, path) parses paths starting with $ into steps — `.name` (identifier), `["key"]` (with \" and \\ escapes), `[N]` (signed integer index, negatives count from the end; only `-?[0-9]+` accepted, rejecting things like `+1`), `.*`/`[*]` (arrays in order, objects by key ascending), and `..name` (pre-order recursive descent over a node and all its descendants, object children sorted by key) — then applies each step as a list-to-list map where inapplicable steps yield nothing. Malformed paths (no $, `$.`, unterminated `[`, `$.1abc`, `$["x]`, trailing junk, etc.) return an error and nil; no matches return an empty non-nil slice. Verified with the existing TestMember plus a temporary spec-coverage test (star, recursion ordering, escapes, non-applicable steps, ~20 malformed paths) which I then removed; `go vet ./...` and `go test ./... -count=1` both exit 0.
